## Summary

- Describe the user-facing outcomes and any changed scope.

## Why this release

Explain the problem addressed and the evidence behind the changes.

## Compatibility notes

State breaking changes or explicitly say there are none. Identify version,
installation names and any changed authorization or environment requirements.

## Validation

- Record package validation, local links and Markdown lint.
- Record installer discovery and resource checks separately from behavior tests.
- Identify untested scenarios and relevant limits.
